summary:
Handy-Andy new-context mascot triggers verified end-to-end via Playwright against a fresh dev-login user (mascot_test_iter8@andyhandy.test) on the preview host. 6 of the 7 spec items PASS; 1 BUG FOUND in the new `first_estimate_approved` context. Detail: (1) onboarding tip 'HEY, I'M ANDY' still fires exactly once on dashboard first-load (regression PASS); (2) safety_low_confidence 'HARD TO CALL' bubble fires when EVALUATE HAZARDS is tapped without a photo (safety-notes field only) — bubble body correctly reads 'For a real evaluation, attach a photo of the site...' PASS; (3) first_estimate_approved 'CUSTOMER SIGNED' bubble fires the first time load() runs on a job whose Mongo doc has `customer_approved_at` set — PASS (seeded doc by pymongo write; body reads 'Estimate approved! Push the parts to checkout...'); (4) an unapproved job open shows NO CUSTOMER SIGNED bubble PASS; (5) help via FAB tap surfaces a tip PASS; (6) Settings HANDY-ANDY HELPER SHOW/HIDE toggle correctly hides mascot-fab immediately (turns section into 'OFF — HIDDEN') PASS. 

🐞 BUG (first_estimate_approved persistence race): After tapping 'Don't show again' on the CUSTOMER SIGNED bubble, `POST /api/mascot/dismiss` completes and `GET /api/mascot/settings` returns `dismissed_contexts=['first_estimate_approved']` — server persistence is fine. However, on reloading the SAME approved job (whether cold URL load OR warm nav from dashboard with 3s wait), the CUSTOMER SIGNED bubble RE-APPEARS. Root cause: in /app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx `load()` fires `showTip` synchronously right after `api.getJob` resolves. The MascotProvider settings fetch (`GET /api/mascot/settings`) races the job fetch; if getJob completes first, `showTip`'s closed-over `dismissed` array is still `[]`, so the dismissed-context filter is bypassed and the bubble expands. The onboarding tip escapes this race because dashboard uses a 900ms setTimeout that gives settings time to arrive. Same fragility exists for `first_bom` and `safety_low_confidence` on cold reload, but they only fire from user gestures (runAI, evaluate button) so the settings fetch is guaranteed to have resolved by then; only `first_estimate_approved`'s auto-fire in load() is user-visible. The bug was NOT present in the prior 4 shipping contexts because none of them auto-fired inside a data-fetch callback on page mount.

📎 Contexts NOT UI-tested this run: `safety_failed` (would require forcing api.safety to throw — code inspection confirms Alert.alert + showTip pair are wired correctly at safety.tsx:89-95) and `first_bom` (would require a base64 photo + real OpenAI vision call — code inspection at job/[id].tsx:181-187 confirms the previousBomLen===0 && nextBomLen>0 gate is correct; note it inherits the same race pattern as first_estimate_approved but the runAI trigger is user-initiated so settings will always be loaded first).

No React-Native / Expo deprecated-package findings. No backend regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: After user taps 'Don't show again' on the CUSTOMER SIGNED bubble and dismissal is persisted server-side (verified via GET /api/mascot/settings → dismissed_contexts:['first_estimate_approved']), reloading the same approved job re-shows the bubble. Race condition — see integration_issues for RCA.

integration_issues.flow: first_estimate_approved dismissal persistence (job page load path)
integration_issues.issue: MascotProvider.settings fetch (GET /api/mascot/settings) races the job page's load() → api.getJob. showTip captures `dismissed` via closure; if getJob resolves first, dismissed=[] so the dismissed-context guard is bypassed and the tip expands even for permanently-dismissed contexts. Fix suggestions: (a) gate showTip on a `settingsLoaded` flag (drop or queue tips fired before settings arrive); (b) use a ref for `dismissed` so showTip always reads the latest value; (c) add a small setTimeout in load() mirroring the dashboard's 900ms delay. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/mascot.tsx:53-94 and /app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx:98-120.

action_items: Fix first_estimate_approved persistence race in /app/frontend/src/lib/mascot.tsx (or job/[id].tsx). Preferred approach: add a `settingsLoaded` boolean to MascotProvider state and make `showTip` no-op (or queue) until settings have been fetched. This will also future-proof first_bom and any other auto-fire-on-mount contexts.

Manually smoke test `safety_failed` (title 'HICCUP') — could not force api.safety to throw from Playwright. Consider seeding a request-body that reliably 400s (e.g. malformed base64) to make this testable.
Consider adding an integration test that verifies a mascot tip fired inside a data-fetch callback respects an already-persisted dismissal on cold reload.
critical_code_review_comments: mascot.tsx:86-94 — `showTip` closes over `dismissed`; the guard `dismissed.includes(next.context)` is only correct if `dismissed` has already been fetched from the server. There is no signal that mascot settings have loaded (initial state is []). Any consumer that calls showTip synchronously on mount (like job/[id].tsx load()) will bypass persisted dismissals on first render.
job/[id].tsx:104-111 — auto-firing showTip inside load() with zero delay is the trigger for the race. Compare to (tabs)/index.tsx:59-69 which safely wraps showTip in a 900ms setTimeout.

job/[id].tsx:181-187 — first_bom gate `previousBomLen===0 && nextBomLen>0` is correct. Because runAI() is user-initiated, mascot settings are guaranteed loaded by then; NOT vulnerable to the same race in practice.

safety.tsx:77-88 — thin-result heuristic (`!imgB64 || (no hazards && no osha_flags && recommendation.length < 20)`) is a reasonable definition of 'low confidence'. Note: `!imgB64` short-circuits the rest, so any evaluate-without-photo call fires HARD TO CALL regardless of how rich the text-only response is. That matches the spec ('WITHOUT attaching a photo') but is worth flagging.
safety.tsx:89-95 — safety_failed tip and Alert.alert are both fired inside the catch block; the spec explicitly requires both, so this is correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To repro the persistence bug: 1) dev-login (POST /api/auth/dev-login secret=andy_01b0fmH1hvFa3gZFz_SDYQvVchp_t5jzBUIKz6kFH5s) 2) via pymongo, `db.jobs.update_one({job_id:<id>},{$set:{customer_approved_at:'<iso>'}})` on any of your seeded jobs 3) navigate to /job/<id>, tap `[data-testid=mascot-dismiss-forever]` on the CUSTOMER SIGNED bubble 4) verify GET /api/mascot/settings shows first_estimate_approved in dismissed_contexts 5) reload /job/<id> → bubble reappears (bug). After fix, step 5 should show NO bubble. Preview host: https://jobsite-assistant.preview.emergentagent.com. Web AsyncStorage shim JSON-encodes values, so seed token with `localStorage.setItem('andy_session_token', JSON.stringify(TOKEN))`.
rca_of_issue: first_estimate_approved dismissal-persistence race — MascotProvider initializes dismissed=[] and asynchronously fetches server settings. showTip is memoized with [dismissed, enabled] so its filter closure over `dismissed` is stale between mount and settings-fetch completion. Consumers that call showTip synchronously inside a load-time useEffect (job/[id].tsx#load) hit the stale-closure window and the persisted-dismissal filter is bypassed. Mitigation: gate showTip on a `settingsLoaded` flag OR read dismissed via a ref that's kept current. The prior 4 contexts (onboarding, diag_*, help) escaped this because either (a) they had a 900ms setTimeout or (b) they fire from user gestures long after settings load.
